councils.name: Bath and North East Somerset
councils.notes: Plain HTTP, needs only a UPRN. The API returns only the next collection date for each bin, so every_weeks says how often each bin is emptied. Frequencies are from the council's own pages (checked 2026-10-26): rubbish every other week (https://www.bathnes.gov.uk/rubbish), food waste weekly (https://www.bathnes.gov.uk/food-waste), green recycling box weekly (https://www.bathnes.gov.uk/green-recycling-box), blue recycling bag weekly (https://www.bathnes.gov.uk/blue-recycling-bag). Garden waste is fortnightly with a seasonal break, but its bin name has not been seen yet, so it is not mapped.
